server.py `/qr` endpoint has no auth; acceptable since the data param is user-provided and output is just a QR. Rate limiting could be considered but not blocking.
report-view.tsx expects `confirmed` field in Report type but doesn't render it anywhere; harmless but could be surfaced as a KPI.
